method: Personal bank wire (SWIFT) through BOC e-banking
status: Lawful - unrestricted for verified current-account purposes
eligibility: Account holder with CNY in a mainland bank account; ID plus source-of-funds or purpose documents where the amount exceeds the annual convenience amount
legal_limit: No annual ceiling on genuine lawful current-account conversion; USD 50,000 equivalent per person per year is only the simplified-processing convenience amount
pros: One tracked transfer; no approval needed; fee capped at CNY 260; published tariff
cons: Bank spread is unavoidable; receiving and correspondent banks may deduct fees not shown here; large amounts invite documentation review

method: Personal bank wire sent full-amount-received (全额到账 / OUR)
status: Lawful - conditional on the branch offering personal OUR
eligibility: Same as M01 plus the branch must support the OUR option and the payment must need an intermediary bank
legal_limit: Same as M01 (no separate limit found)
pros: Recipient receives the full principal; intermediary deductions are borne by you at a fixed published price
cons: Extra USD 15 or USD 25 per transfer; only available where the receiving bank has no direct account relationship with BOC

method: Personal bank wire split into one transfer per USD 50,000 convenience amount
eligibility: PRC-resident individual (境内个人) using the simplified procedure; a foreign passport holder must be classified by the bank first
legal_limit: USD 50,000 equivalent per person per year under the simplified procedure; eight calendar years for USD 400,000
pros: No documents beyond ID for each tranche; smallest documentation burden per transfer
cons: Eight wire fees instead of one; eight years of exchange-rate exposure; splitting a single payment to dodge documentation is prohibited

method: Emigrant property transfer (移民财产转移)
eligibility: Person who held the property before emigrating and has cancelled PRC household registration; applied at the SAFE branch of the original registration location
legal_limit: No published cap on the approved amount; SAFE approves case by case; funds may be remitted once or in instalments within the approval
pros: The only route for pre-emigration property proceeds; the RMB 500,000 filing step was cancelled in 2014
cons: Needs hukou cancellation and proof of settlement abroad; SAFE approval fee is not published (left blank); bank mechanics cost the same as M01

method: Inheritance property transfer (继承财产转移)
eligibility: Heir of a deceased account holder; applied at the SAFE branch of the deceased's former registration location
legal_limit: No published cap; SAFE approves case by case
pros: Covers inherited balances that have no current-account income story
cons: Probate and heirship documents; approval timing not published; bank mechanics as M01

method: Cash withdrawal plus hand-carry across the border
legal_limit: Up to USD 5,000 customs release; USD 5,000-10,000 needs a bank 携带外汇出境许可证; above USD 10,000 needs a SAFE permit and is in principle not allowed; the US side reports above USD 10,000
pros: No bank wire fee; no correspondent chain; USD in hand
cons: Counter cash rates are not published; physical loss and seizure risk; two reporting regimes; not usable for USD 400,000

method: Overseas ATM withdrawals on a mainland card
eligibility: Mainland-issued debit card; cash is dispensed abroad in local currency
legal_limit: CNY 100,000 equivalent per natural year across all your cards; CNY 10,000 per card per day; breach suspends this year and next year
pros: No application and no documents; works while travelling
cons: The annual ceiling is about USD 14,000 and cannot move USD 400,000; per-withdrawal fees and the card scheme's FX rate are commercial and were not re-verified in an official tariff today

status: Lawful only if SAFE-licensed for the specific purpose
eligibility: Only for a purpose the licence covers (for example cross-border e-commerce settlement); not for moving personal savings
legal_limit: No personal-capital purpose found in the SAFE payment-institution rules; platform fees are commercial
pros: Often a cheaper headline fee than a bank wire
cons: Not a personal-savings channel; fee and FX margin are contractual; counterparty risk

method: QDII fund or Cross-boundary Wealth Management Connect
status: Lawful but not a conversion route
eligibility: Residency, investment-history and quota conditions set by the scheme; eligibility for this person is unknown
legal_limit: Scheme quotas apply per investor and per scheme; the exact figure for a US citizen was not confirmed
pros: Moves money through an approved investment wrapper
cons: Turns an exit problem into an investment decision; product fees and lock-ups are not verified here; may create PFIC reporting in the US

method: Quota splitting / crypto / underground bank / false invoices
legal_limit: Administrative fine up to 30% of the amount (30%-100% if serious) plus a repatriation order; criminal liability where the thresholds are met
cons: Two legal systems at once: PRC administrative or criminal exposure and US money-laundering exposure; also the usual source of the 'huge tax penalty' stories
